description: The last-record boundary, in isolation: the fixture's final row, key 9805583408996588. The same three-line shape as case03 over a different record, and it is worth its own case because the highest key in the file is where a browse that positions at-or-after its start key and a READ that walks forward can most easily disagree about whether one more record exists. Here the record is delivered ('00' at app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:94, DISPLAY at :78) and the following READ reports '10' (:98, then :107-108), so the file ends immediately after its last record rather than one record early or one record late.
